278.commentary: (SNa) ratho akūjano'ti aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo'va adhippeto. yathā hi pākatikaratho akkhe vā anabbhañjite atirekesu vā manussesu abhiruḷhesu kūjati viravati, na evaṃ ariyamaggo.

examples.text: ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.

279.meaning2: not false; not crooked; not corrupt

280.meaning2: not deceitful, not false; not wild, not vicious

283.meaning1: not treacherous; not deceitful; not fraudulent; not corrupt; honest

examples.text: ye pana te kulaputtā saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā asaṭhā amāyāvino aketabino anuddhatā anunnaḷā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
yatra hi nāma aniccaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ niccan'ti vakkhati, addhuvaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ dhuvan'ti vakkhati, asassataṃ'y'eva samānaṃ sassatan'ti vakkhati, akevalaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ kevalan'ti vakkhati

285.construction:
na > a + kevala + ī
akevala + ī

examples.text: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.

287.meaning1: not engaging in noisy debates and auspicious ceremonies
287.meaning2: trusting in omens and portents; setting store by ceremonies and auspicious rites; superstitious

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, akotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, kammaṃ pacceti no maṅgalaṃ, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'cā'ti.
paṇḍito'ti samaññāto, sāriputto akodhano, app'iccho sorato danto, satthuvaṇṇ'ābhato isī'ti.
samitāvino vītarāgā akopā, yesaṃ gatī n'atth'idha vippahāya, kālena tesu habyaṃ pavecche, yo brāhmaṇo puññapekkho yajetha.

291.construction:
na > a + kusala > kosala + ya
akusala + ya

292.commentary: (SNt) akosallasambhūte'ti akosallaṃ vuccati avijjā, tato sambhūte. avijjāpubbaṅ'gamā hi sabbe pāpadhammā.

examples.text: pāpake'ti lāmake. akusale dhamme'ti akosallasambhūte dhamme. ṭhānaso antaradhāpetī'ti khaṇen'eva antaradhāpeti vikkhambheti.

293.meaning1: unskilled (in); not expert (in); not proficient (in); not a master (of)

examples.text: satañ'ca vivaṭaṃ hoti, āloko passatām'iva, santike na vijānanti, magā dhammass'akovidā.
idha, gahapati, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati

295.commentary: (MNa) akkassā'ti akkavāke gahetvā jiyaṃ karonti. tena vuttaṃ akkassā'ti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ jiyaṃ jānāmi yāy'amhi viddho, yadi vā akkassa yadi vā saṇhassa yadi vā nhārussa yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti.

297.meaning1: stood on; stepped on; trodden on (by)
297.commentary: (VINa) akkantassā'ti chattadaṇḍake aṅgul'antaraṃ appavesetvā kevalaṃ pādukaṃ akkamitvā ṭhitassa.

examples.text: na pāduk'āruḷhassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca akkantassa vā paṭimukkassa vā omukkassa vā agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

299.meaning1: every place stepped; each and every place trodden
